def _toml_value(value):
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return '[' + ', '.join(_toml_value(v) for v in value) + ']'
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return json.dumps(value)
    return str(value)


def to_toml(entries):
    out = []
    for entry in entries:
        out.append('[[suite]]')
        for key, value in entry.items():
            out.append(f'{key} = {_toml_value(value)}')
        out.append('')
    return '\n'.join(out)


def copy_base():
    return [dict(e, **{k: list(v) for k, v in e.items() if isinstance(v, list)}) for e in BASE]


def write_tree(root, entries=None, extra_files=()):
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (root / 'build').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (root / 'build' / 'suites.toml').write_text(to_toml(entries if entries is not None else BASE))
    for rel in ('pkg/test_a.py', 'pkg/sub/test_b.py', 'other/test_c.py', *extra_files):
        path = root / rel
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text('def test_x():\n    pass\n')
    return root


def git(root, *args):
    subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(root), *args], check=True, capture_output=True)


def git_tree(root, entries=None, extra_files=(), untracked=(), gitignore=None):
    write_tree(root, entries, extra_files)
    if gitignore is not None:
        (root / '.gitignore').write_text(gitignore)
    git(root, 'init', '-q')
    git(root, 'add', '-A')
    for rel in untracked:
        path = root / rel
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text('def test_x():\n    pass\n')
    return root


def data_of(entries=None):
    return tomllib.loads(to_toml(entries if entries is not None else BASE))


def suites_by_name(entries=None):
    return {s.name: s for s in rs.parse(data_of(entries))}


class Recorder:
    def __init__(self, codes=None):
        self.calls = []
        self.codes = codes or {}

    def __call__(self, root, run):
        self.calls.append(run)
        print(f'<<run {run.label}>>')
        return self.codes.get(run.label, 0)

def _base_claude_md():
    proc = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(REPO), 'show', f'{BASE_COMMIT}:CLAUDE.md'],
                          capture_output=True, text=True)
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        pytest.skip(f'{BASE_COMMIT} not available')
    return proc.stdout.splitlines()


def _base_commands():
    lines = _base_claude_md()
    picked = lines[65:125] + lines[144:145]
    forms = set()
    for line in picked:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line.startswith('cd '):
            continue
        parts = line.split(' && ')
        for part in parts[1:]:
            forms.add(f'{parts[0]} && {part}')
    return forms
